status.scope: finite table recomputation and storage measurement only, no Lean proof

scope: Bounded prefix of the 4258 signed formula bank orbit representatives; all recorded tables recomputed closed, but the last touched formula1 parent may have unfinished copy children. This is measured data volume, not a lower bound on optimal certificate size or a Lean replay. Encoding contains n roots, number of derived entries, then (op,left,right) per derived entry, followed by sorted distinct rejecting row pairs encoded as (positive<<10)|negative; every integer uses unsigned LEB128. Root banks, table order and child-parent associations are supplied separately in JSON/input. No decoder or certificate checker is claimed.
